known.note: Meilele (China home-furnishing e-commerce, founded 2008): 'In April 2011, Lightspeed Venture Partners led Meilele's Series A financing in its first institutional round' (the June 2012 $40M Series B release, which Lightspeed China Partners joined). A global-fund entry before the 2011 LCP spin-out, so a member under ruling 5. Still trading in 2019 (2018 revenue CNY 832M, stores cut below 260; bjnews, 2019-06); nothing later found, so status unknown. Dongyi Easyhome sold its 2.18% for $12.8M in 2017 (about $590M implied): below $1B.
